span.span: - It does not make sense to repeat the same action if the observation does not change.
<!SYNTH>If the current observation indicates that no door is present, do not attempt to toggle and instead continue exploring (e.g., turn or move forward).<SYNTH!>
: <one of: turn left, turn right, go forward, pick up, drop, toggle>
+ACTION: <one of: turn left, turn right, go forward, pick up, drop, toggle>+
